description.$value: Component tokens for the Card molecule — spacing, size, color (bg, border, fg and the state colors, with inverse pairs), shadow, typography, border radius and border width, plus the selection indicator of the checkbox and radio types. States (interaction, availability, selection, focus) are Figma component variants; their values live in the color and border_width keys.

padding_top.$description: Top padding of the content area below the image.

padding_right.$description: Right padding of the content area. Same as the left padding so the text block sits centered.

padding_bottom.$description: Bottom padding of the content area, below the last slot (footer or buttons).

padding_left.$description: Left padding of the content area. Same as the right padding so the text block sits centered.

row_gap.$description: Vertical gap between the slots of the content area: alert, header, text, footer and buttons.

col_gap.$description: Horizontal gap between the header icon or avatar and the title block.
Horizontal gap between the left and the right footer text.
Horizontal gap between the buttons in the card button group.

height.$description: Default height of the image slot. The image fills the full card width.

width.$description: Width and height of the header avatar or icon.

bg_inverse.$description: Background color of the card on a flipped surface.

border_inverse.$description: Border color of the card on a flipped surface.

fg.$description: Color of the title and the body text.

fg_inverse.$description: Color of the title and the body text on a flipped surface.

fg_subtle.$description: Color of the subtitle and the footer text.

fg_subtle_inverse.$description: Color of the subtitle and the footer text on a flipped surface.

bg_hover.$description: Background color of the card on hover.

bg_hover_inverse.$description: Background color of the card on hover on a flipped surface.

bg_active.$description: Background color of the card while it is pressed.

bg_active_inverse.$description: Background color of the card while it is pressed on a flipped surface.

bg_disabled.$description: Background color of a disabled card.

bg_disabled_inverse.$description: Background color of a disabled card on a flipped surface.

border_hover.$description: Border color of the card on hover.

border_hover_inverse.$description: Border color of the card on hover on a flipped surface.

border_active.$description: Border color of the card while it is pressed.

border_active_inverse.$description: Border color of the card while it is pressed on a flipped surface.

border_selected.$description: Border color of a selected card.

border_selected_inverse.$description: Border color of a selected card on a flipped surface.

border_focus.$description: Border color of a focused card, the focus ring.

border_focus_inverse.$description: Border color of a focused card, the focus ring on a flipped surface.

border_disabled.$description: Border color of a disabled card.

border_disabled_inverse.$description: Border color of a disabled card on a flipped surface.

fg_disabled.$description: Text color of a disabled card.

fg_disabled_inverse.$description: Text color of a disabled card on a flipped surface.

border_radius.$description: Corner radius of the card. The image slot is clipped to it.

default.$description: Border width of the card surface.

selected.$description: Border width of a selected card.

focus.$description: Border width of a focused card, the focus ring.

default.$description: Shadow of the card at rest.

hover.$description: Shadow of the card on hover.

width.$description: Width and height of the selection indicator of the checkbox and radio card types.

icon.$description: Size of the checkmark inside the checkbox indicator.

dot.$description: Diameter of the dot inside the radio indicator.

inset.$description: Distance of the indicator from the top and right edge of the card.

checkbox.$description: Corner radius of the checkbox indicator.

radio.$description: Corner radius of the radio indicator, a full circle.

bg.$description: Background color of the unselected indicator.

bg_inverse.$description: Background color of the unselected indicator on a flipped surface.

bg_selected.$description: Background color of the selected indicator.

bg_selected_inverse.$description: Background color of the selected indicator on a flipped surface.

fg_selected.$description: Color of the checkmark and the dot on the selected indicator.

fg_selected_inverse.$description: Color of the checkmark and the dot on the selected indicator on a flipped surface.

border_inverse.$description: Border color of the indicator on a flipped surface.

border_disabled.$description: Border color of the indicator on a disabled card.

border_disabled_inverse.$description: Border color of the indicator on a disabled card on a flipped surface.
